title: energese: Odum's Energy Systems Language as a LuaLaTeX package
description:
energese renders H. T. Odum's Energy Systems Language (ESL) diagrams from a declarative model, in JSON or in TeX, as a LuaLaTeX package.

Symbol geometry is measured from Odum's published symbol sheet and checked against it on every build; layout is derived from the model, placing components by transformity and routing pathways around the symbols they do not connect to. A diagram is therefore a function of its model rather than a drawing maintained beside it, which is what lets a published figure be regenerated when the model changes.

Correctness is asserted at three levels: golden-image regression against approved renders, geometric conformance against measurements taken from Odum's own sheet, and a parity check requiring the JSON and TeX front ends to rasterise identically.
